decisions.reason: Presented on its own page and closely aligned with established upholstery range, indicating solid support.
Decorative bouclé effect is on-trend and complements the existing decorative fabrics, though less prominent on the website.
Flame-retardant features support contract projects and the product has its own page, suggesting strong market fit.
Double-face wool-blend offers premium differentiation and builds on established offer, warranting further market testing.
Semi-transparent wool bouclé leno is more specialized but still fits the collection and may need time to gain traction.
